scope: sampled visual and story review; ASR and measured signal support; no validated audio listening
product_from_film: Sam is a small home companion device shown giving reminders and sharing daily-activity updates about an older adult.
explains_well: A single day connects cooking, breakfast, medication, gardening and a family dinner around the same person and device.
unclear: The film does not explain how Sam knows an activity happened, who receives the updates or how the older adult controls sharing.
scenario: Support daily routines and keep family informed while an older adult lives at home.
product_clear_basis: A Sam notification says Nai Nai has eaten breakfast after the kitchen scene.

lessons.keep: Keep the product inside one continuous human day, with task moments that support the final payoff.
lessons.avoid: Avoid implying reliable observation from an activity notification without showing how it is confirmed.
lessons.open: Activity confirmation, sharing controls, missed-reminder handling, hardware behavior, later dialogue and all audio remain unverified.
try: Follow a Tin user through a launch day, showing brief helpful actions before the team sees the finished campaign.
Pair an automatic update with a visible recipient and an easy control for what is shared.
